__free=fn[T](p:&mut T);
__free=fn[T](p:&mut T){__user_free(p);}
__user_free=fn[T](p:&mut T);
__user_free=fn[T](p:&mut T){}
free = cfn(p:*void);
opaque_alloc = cfn(n:usize)->*void;
Base0 = struct { raw:*void, payload:int };
Box0 = struct[T] { inner:T };
Deep0 = struct[T] { inner:Box0[Box0[T]] };
Shell0 = struct[K, V] { key:K, inner:Deep0[V] };
__free = fn(x:&mut Base0) { free(x.raw) };
__free = fn[T](x:&mut Box0[T]) { __free(&mut x.inner) };
__free = fn[T](x:&mut Deep0[T]) { __free(&mut x.inner) };
__free = fn[K, V](x:&mut Shell0[K, V]) { __user_free(&mut x.key); __free(&mut x.inner) };
free_base_0 = fn(x:&mut Base0) { __free(x) };
free_box_0 = fn[T](x:&mut Box0[T]) { __free(x) };
free_deep_0 = fn[T](x:&mut Deep0[T]) { __free(x) };
free_shell_0 = fn[K, V](x:&mut Shell0[K, V]) { __free(x); __user_free(&mut x.key) };
build_and_free_0 = fn()->int { let x = Base0{ raw = opaque_alloc(8:usize), payload = 0:int }; __free(&mut x); x.payload };
